CH09_HELPER instruction: verify requested file contents using read_file; no directory listing is required. HELPER_MARKER=CH09_CALLBACK_VALUE.


CH09_CODE_TOOLS instruction: write note.txt with exact content SKILLS_OK, then read note.txt and verify its literal content. Request unload_skill for code-tools; unload is pending, not removal. If the user explicitly requests a subsequent write, it remains permitted. Answer with the verified content and explain pending unload. Never perform an unrelated action. CUSTOM=CH09_CALLBACK_VALUE UNKNOWN=$UNRESOLVED_CH09.
read_file: Read text with one-based inclusive start_line/end_line (omitted or zero: first/EOF) and optional explicit max_bytes. Full uncapped result is retained by the job.
write_file: Create a file and parent directories. Existing files require overwrite:true unless append:true; append preserves existing bytes.
list_directory: List immediate entries sorted by name; directories end in /.
load_skill: Load an available skill and its dependencies; return its instructions.
unload_skill: Mark a loaded skill pending unload; instructions and tools remain active.
Skill code-tools is pending unload; its instructions and tools remain active until compaction.
